AGB water-bucket AOX → bio3 'AOX, Adsorbable Organic Halogen' (water). bucket-agnostic source means bio3 lookup uses the AGB exchange's actual bucket, so this only resolves for water-compartment exchanges. Air variant is handled by the next entry (EF v3.1 target). Also overrides the broken randonneur tier-2 mapping that pointed to non-existent name 'AOX, Adsorbable Organic Halogen as Cl' or 'Halides'.

AGB air-emission AOX has no biosphere3 equivalent (bio3 holds the substance in water only). Pin to EF v3.1 'adsorbable organic halogen compounds' (Emissions to air, unspecified) — same substance under different naming, with CFs in Human toxicity (non-cancer) and Ecotoxicity (freshwater).

AGB Ra-226 (kg, water) -> ecoinvent Ra-226 (kBq) via specific activity 3.65e10 kBq/kg (T½=1600y, M=0.226 kg/mol)
AGB Ra-228 (kg, water) -> ecoinvent Ra-228 (kBq) via specific activity 1.01e13 kBq/kg (T½=5.75y, M=0.228 kg/mol)
AGB 'Kaolin ore' (resource, in ground, kg) -> biosphere3 'Kaolinite' (resource, in ground, kg). Kaolin ore is the natural deposit of kaolinite clay.

AGB 'Natural aggregate' (resource, kg) -> biosphere3 'Sand, unspecified' (resource, in ground, kg). Aggregate (gravel/sand mix) approximated as sand for impact assessment; ecoinvent has no dedicated 'aggregate' resource flow.

AGB 'Methane' (resource, kg) -> ecoinvent 'Gas, natural' (Sm³). Methane density at STP ≈ 0.717 kg/Sm³ → 1 kg methane ≈ 1.395 Sm³. Approximation: AGB likely uses 'Methane' generically for natural gas extraction; biosphere3 has no separate methane resource flow.

AGB 'Crude oil' as water emission has no equivalent. biosphere3 'Oil, crude' is a resource flow only. The resource↔emission firewall (and chemistry difference: extracted resource vs spilled pollutant) makes the bridge inappropriate.

AGB Asbestos (air emission) has no biosphere3/EF counterpart. biosphere3 'Chrysotile' is a mineral-resource flow, not an air-pollution emission flow; mapping would conflate dispersed-fiber pollution with raw-mineral extraction.
AGB resource flow 'Potashsalt, crude' has no biosphere3 resource equivalent. biosphere3 'Potassium chloride' exists only as emission flows (air/water/soil), not as a resource extraction.

AGB 'Soil' as kg-mass resource has no biosphere3 counterpart. Soil-loss in biosphere3 is expressed as land occupation (m²-year), which requires bulk-density × depth assumptions to bridge from kg — too much uncertainty for a defensible default.
AGB 'Thifensulfuron' (soil, kg) = thifensulfuron-methyl. Exists in ecoinvent-3.9.1-biosphere and EF [soil].
AGB 'Biological pest controls' (soil, kg) is an aggregate placeholder for biocontrol agents. No individual biosphere3 / EF flow can represent the heterogeneous mix.
Generic 'Emission, unspecified' has no LCIA-quantified flow; the placeholder name carries no chemistry.
Generic 'Unspecified input' has no resource-flow equivalent in biosphere3 / EF; SimaPro placeholder for unmodelled inputs.

AGB 'Wood, dry matter' (kg dry biomass) -> ecoinvent 'Wood, unspecified, standing' (m³). Typical dry-wood density ≈ 600 kg/m³ → 1/600 ≈ 0.00167 m³/kg. Approximate (species-dependent ±30%); acceptable for LCIA screening.

entries.source_name: Wood and wood waste, 9.5 MJ per kg
entries.notes: AGB 'Wood and wood waste, 9.5 MJ/kg' -> ecoinvent 'Wood, unspecified, standing' (m³). 9.5 MJ/kg LHV implies ~30% moisture; wet-wood density ≈ 800 kg/m³ → 1/800 = 0.00125 m³/kg.

entries.source_name: Correction flow for delayed emission of biogenic carbon dioxide
entries.notes: AGB SimaPro temporal-correction flow (kg·year unit). Captures delayed-emission integral for dynamic LCA / GWP-T methods; biosphere3 / EF have no flow with kg·year units, and collapsing to kg loses the time dimension. Recognize as dead-end rather than approximate.

AGB 'Waste water/m3' (m³, water emission) has no biosphere3 / EF emission flow. The LLM-suggested target 'Non-hazardous waste disposed' is mass-keyed (kg) and conceptually different (treated waste vs untreated wastewater discharge); the volume↔mass collapse is too lossy to default.

AGB 'Radionuclides (Including Radon)' (kg, air) is an aggregate group across heterogeneous nuclides. No single specific-activity factor can convert kg to kBq for the mix; biosphere3 only has nuclide-specific flows.
AGB 'Ruthenium' (kg, water) is generic elemental Ru. The tier-3 mapping target 'Ruthenium-103' would conflate elemental Ru with a specific isotope; biosphere3 has no kg-mass elemental-Ru emission.
AGB 'Glufosinate' (air) = glufosinate ammonium (salt form). Exists in ecoinvent-3.9.1-biosphere and biosphere3 [air].
AGB 'Iodosulfuron' (air) = iodosulfuron-methyl-sodium. Exists in EF [air].
AGB 'Primisulfuron' (air) = primisulfuron-methyl. Exists in EF [air].
